title: Unity
lyrics:
[01:58.90]Stand together like we're rocks in a wall
[02:03.41]Growing stronger everyday, even more
[02:07.98]Stand together in the eye of the storm
[02:12.02]And show the whole world who we are, oh
[02:17.17]Keep on walking to the sound of the drums
[02:21.70]Feel the fire run through our lungs
[02:26.29]Find our treasure in the light of the sun
[02:30.28]And show the whole world who we are, oh
